title: Ski Day Vertical Metres and Runs
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=snow:run
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(vertical_m) as vertical, count as runs, max(top_speed_kmh) as top_speed by _time
| sort - _time
description: Totals the vertical metres, runs, and top speed of each ski or snowboard day, capturing the numbers behind the fun.
value: Vertical-metre totals are the classic ski bragging right, and tracking them across a season shows how much you rode.
implementation: Ingest ski-tracker runs into `index=personal`; total vertical, runs, and top speed per day.
visualization: Column chart of daily vertical metres with run count.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up how far you descended, how many runs, and your top speed each ski day.
